name: India Legal Templates
note: Statute citations verified 2026-10-28. All templates are drafts pending advocate review; see REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md.

templates.title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.summary: Two-way confidentiality agreement for Indian parties exploring a business relationship, with AI-training restrictions and arbitration.

templates.title: One-Way Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.summary: Disclosing-party-friendly confidentiality agreement for sharing a company's information with a single recipient.

templates.title: Master Services Agreement
templates.summary: Balanced framework agreement for technology and IT services delivered under individual Statements of Work.

templates.title: Privacy Notice (DPDP Act, 2023)
templates.summary: Standalone, itemised privacy notice for an Indian website or app acting as a Data Fiduciary under the DPDP Act, 2023.

templates.title: Terms of Use (Website and App)
templates.summary: Website and app terms for an Indian platform, with IT Rules, 2021 content and grievance procedures.

templates.title: Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement
templates.summary: Confirmatory and prior-inventions IP assignment by a founder, employee or contractor, with full Copyright Act s.19 particulars.

templates.title: Employee Stock Option Plan
templates.summary: ESOP for an unlisted Indian company under s.62(1)(b) Companies Act and Rule 12, with grant letter and shareholder resolution.

templates.title: Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Policy
templates.summary: Workplace sexual harassment policy under the POSH Act, 2013 and Rules: Internal Committee, inquiry, interim relief and complaint form.

templates.title: Employment Agreement
templates.summary: Full employment agreement for a managerial or professional employee, aligned with the Labour Codes, DPDP and s.27 ICA.

templates.title: Advisor Agreement
templates.summary: Agreement engaging a startup advisor in India, covering services, time commitment, equity or cash compensation and IP.

templates.title: Generative AI Acceptable Use Policy
templates.summary: Internal policy governing employees' use of generative AI tools in India: approved tools, prohibited inputs and outputs.

templates.title: Board Resolutions Pack for a Private Company
templates.summary: Ten commonly used board resolutions for an Indian private company in certified-true-copy format.

templates.title: Consultancy Agreement
templates.summary: Agreement engaging an independent consultant or contractor in India, with fees, GST, TDS and IP assignment.

templates.title: Cookie and Tracking Technologies Notice
templates.summary: Notice explaining cookies, SDKs and similar technologies on an Indian website or app.

templates.title: Data Processing Agreement (DPDP Act, 2023)
templates.summary: Data Fiduciary to Data Processor agreement under section 8(2) of the DPDP Act, 2023.

templates.title: Distribution Agreement
templates.summary: Appointment of a buy-sell distributor for products in a defined Indian territory, with exclusivity terms.

templates.title: Employee Handbook
templates.summary: Complete employee handbook for an Indian company covering conduct, leave, remote work and policies.

templates.title: Founders' Agreement
templates.summary: Agreement among co-founders of an Indian private limited company covering roles, shareholding, vesting and exit.

templates.title: iSAFE Note (CCPS Subscription Agreement)
templates.summary: India-adapted SAFE: early-stage investment through CCPS that convert at the next qualified round.

templates.title: Offer Letter
templates.summary: Offer of employment for an Indian company setting out role, CTC breakdown, joining date and conditions.

templates.title: SaaS Subscription Agreement
templates.summary: B2B software-as-a-service terms between a provider and an enterprise customer, with order forms and DPDP provisions.

templates.title: Service Level Agreement
templates.summary: Service level schedule for SaaS or managed services: availability, maintenance and support commitments.

templates.title: Shareholders' Agreement (Post Priced Round)
templates.summary: Shareholders' agreement among an Indian private company, its founders and investors after a priced round.

templates.title: Statement of Work
templates.summary: Project-level Statement of Work issued under a Master Services Agreement, with milestones and change control.

templates.title: Term Sheet for Seed / Series A (CCPS)
templates.summary: Term sheet for a priced seed or Series A round in an Indian private company issuing CCPS.

templates.title: Vendor Agreement
templates.summary: Customer-leaning procurement framework for buying goods or services from a supplier through purchase orders.
